# Menu (`menu`)

Dropdown and context menus with icons, shortcuts and submenus.

Group: Overlays. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/overlays';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createIconButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/iconButton.d.ts`): `.mh-icon-button`: a round, icon-only button at least a touch target wide.

```ts
export function createIconButton(options: IconButtonOptions): IconButtonHandle;

export interface IconButtonOptions {
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** Required: the button's accessible name (also its tooltip). */
  label: string;
  tone?: IconButtonTone;
  size?: IconButtonSize;
  /** A filled circle (raised surface) rather than a bare glyph. */
  filled?: boolean;
  /** Toggle buttons: sets `aria-pressed`. */
  pressed?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface IconButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setIcon(icon: IconName | string): void;
  setPressed(pressed: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createMenu` (types in `dist/web/overlays/menu.d.ts`): `.mh-menu` (`role="menu"`): a list of `.mh-menu__item` actions (`--danger`, `aria-disabled`) and `.mh-menu__separator`s, anchored to a button. Arrow keys, Home and End move a roving focus, typing a letter jumps to the next item starting with it, Enter or Space chooses, Escape closes back to the button, Tab closes.

```ts
export function createMenu(options: MenuOptions): MenuHandle;

export interface MenuOptions {
  /** The button that opens the menu; it gets `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. */
  anchor: HTMLElement;
  items: readonly MenuEntry[];
  onSelect?: (value: string) => void;
  /** Default `bottom-start`; flips when there's no room. */
  placement?: MenuPlacement;
  /** Portals into the nearest `[data-mh-theme]` ancestor of this element (default: the anchor's). */
  container?: HTMLElement | null;
}

export interface MenuHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  open(focus?: 'first' | 'last'): void;
  close(): void;
  isOpen(): boolean;
  setItems(items: readonly MenuEntry[]): void;
  /** Detaches the menu and its listeners from the anchor. */
  destroy(): void;
}

export type MenuEntry = MenuItem | MenuSeparator;

export interface MenuItem {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** Shown on the right, e.g. "Ctrl+D". Display only. */
  shortcut?: string;
  danger?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
}
```

`h` (types in `dist/web/dom.d.ts`): Creates an element: string and number attributes are set, `true` sets an empty attribute, `on*` functions become listeners.

```ts
export function h<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(tag: K, attrs: Attrs = {}, ...children: Child[]): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K];
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createIconButton, createMenu, h } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = h('p', { 'aria-live': 'polite' });
const more = createIconButton({ icon: 'more', label: 'Scene actions' });

createMenu({
  anchor: more.el,
  items: [
    { value: 'edit', label: 'Edit', icon: 'edit', shortcut: 'E' },
    { value: 'duplicate', label: 'Duplicate', icon: 'copy', shortcut: 'Ctrl+D' },
    { value: 'share', label: 'Share', icon: 'share' },
    { separator: true },
    { value: 'delete', label: 'Delete', icon: 'delete', danger: true },
  ],
  onSelect: (value) => (status.textContent = `Chosen: ${value}`),
});

document.body.append(more.el, status);
```

## React API

`IconButton` (types in `dist/react/actions.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createIconButton`.

```ts
export function IconButton({ icon, label, tone, size, filled, pressed, className, ...rest }: IconButtonProps);

export interface IconButtonProps extends Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'children'> {
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** Required: the accessible name (also the tooltip). */
  label: string;
  tone?: IconButtonTone;
  size?: IconButtonSize;
  filled?: boolean;
  pressed?: boolean;
}
```

`Menu` (types in `dist/react/overlays.d.ts`): `createMenu` on its child button. The wrapper is `display: contents`.

```ts
export function Menu({ items, onSelect, placement, children }: MenuProps);

export interface MenuProps {
  items: readonly MenuEntry[];
  onSelect?: (value: string) => void;
  placement?: MenuPlacement;
  /** The trigger: one button element (it gets the menu-button ARIA). */
  children: ReactElement;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { IconButton, Menu } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { MenuEntry } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const items: MenuEntry[] = [
  { value: 'edit', label: 'Edit', icon: 'edit', shortcut: 'E' },
  { value: 'duplicate', label: 'Duplicate', icon: 'copy', shortcut: 'Ctrl+D' },
  { value: 'share', label: 'Share', icon: 'share' },
  { separator: true },
  { value: 'delete', label: 'Delete', icon: 'delete', danger: true },
];

export function MenuExample() {
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState('');
  return (
    <>
      <Menu items={items} onSelect={setChosen}>
        <IconButton icon="more" label="Scene actions" />
      </Menu>
      <p aria-live="polite">{chosen && `Chosen: ${chosen}`}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```
